title: 2004 carrier encounter: drop from 81,000 ft

tellings.quote: they had a craft at 80 I think it was 81,000 ft. It was like over 15 miles straight up in the air and they sent planes up to that area. And when they could just start seeing it on their instruments, it dropped down to 24 in above the water surface in under one second.

plain: Charlie Foltz, who describes himself as a witness, retells what he was told about a 2004 encounter off the coast of California, near a US Navy aircraft carrier group. According to his account, a craft sat at about 81,000 feet, over 15 miles up, and when planes were sent toward it and it began to show on their instruments, it dropped to about 24 inches above the water in under a second. If true, it would describe a machine moving far beyond any known aircraft.
